text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—The Generating Cycle of the Five Elements.
Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Kindle a fire from firewood, eat the cooked bounties of the earth, and run. Through that cycle――I shall elevate both my muscle and my mind!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Even the repetition of a plain cycle is part of feng shui.
If I can maintain this at a high level until the final day of training camp—!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaah!!
Copano Rickey trained diligently every single day without fail. As a result—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Traineeerrr, I'm totally pooped...

Though utterly exhausted...
the improvement was plainly visible.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm kinda touched... I always thought Ricky-chan
was more of an airhead, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You're an incredible hard worker, aren't you?
I guess I kind of got the wrong impression...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A hard worker... am I?
I'm simply moving forward with single-minded focus
toward what I know to be the right path.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to make everyone happy.
And Trainer will teach me how to get stronger to do just that♪
choice_data_list: Good work. You kept up well.
Good work. You kept up well.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Plus, I had Falco-san's
support this summer.

That mud-stained body was—truly
a symbol of having given everything she had to give.

Seeing Copano Rickey as she is now,
Hokko Tarumae might feel something too, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...It's frustrating, isn't it?
Not being able to cheer Tarumae up directly.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If I send photos, she'll probably feel self-conscious and withdraw even more...
She takes everything more seriously than anyone else, after all.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Even Feng Shui can't do anything about this...

The flow of qi connecting Copano Rickey and Hokko Tarumae remains faint.
All that's left is to leave it to fate...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah! In that case...
Maybe it's time for an umadol to take the stage!
choice_data_list: Huh, time for the Umadol to shine?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah! If there are parts of feng shui you struggle with, maybe I can help.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Rickey-chan! Wanna shoot a quick video?
To commemorate the end of training camp☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: A video? Yeah, sure.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Rickeyâ Luckyâ Mega Special Training!!
We finally made it through the brutal
training camp workout!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
With Falco-san's help, I pushed myself
to the absolute limit! Totally satisfied☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: This is for my dream, too. To make everyone happy through the power of feng shui. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I won't give up! For the sake of those only I can bring happiness to, I'll charge forward, forward, forward!
Yeah!☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's all♪ This was Copano Rickey!
To everyone watching Falco-san's UmaTok, thanks for having me!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Falco-san, was that good?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, all good☆
I think that's about all I can do.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All that's left... is up to Tarumae-chan.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because even now, she might still be watching
videos of Umadols and locodols at least.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All that's left is to believe and wait☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: This is for my dream, too. To make everyone happy through the power of feng shui. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I won't give up! For the sake of those only I can bring happiness to, I'll charge forward, forward, forward!
Yeah!☆

…………
Ugh... Ngggh...!

The umadol, Smart Falcon,
has opened up as much of a small breakthrough as she could.

Let us believe that a new autumn wind will blow in from there.
A tailwind for both Copano Rickey and Hokko Tarumae.
